claims.statement: DemoCo mines solo with its own fleet, receives every coinbase output to an address it controls, and uses no pool and sells no hash power.

claims.conclusion: Principal; ASC 606 by analogy; mining revenue caption.
claims.statement: DemoCo is the principal for the mining service; with no customer identified, ASC 606 is applied by analogy and block rewards are presented as mining revenue.

claims.conclusion: Recognize on block acceptance; recognition-date price.
claims.statement: Block rewards are recognized on the date the block is accepted and its coinbase output pays to the DemoCo-controlled address, measured at that date's price; the 100-block maturity is a spending restriction, not a recognition criterion.

claims.conclusion: Schedule recomputes and ties to chain.
claims.statement: April 2026 block rewards of 9.545 BTC (subsidy 9.375 plus fees 0.17) are measured at recognition-date fair value totalling 677,725 USD and tie to the node export.

claims.conclusion: Subsequent accounting under ASC 350-60; separate revenue caption.
claims.statement: Mined BTC is an in-scope crypto asset subsequently measured at fair value under ASC 350-60 with remeasurement in net income; mining revenue is presented in its own caption with the fleet's energy and depreciation as cost of revenue.
